columns.name: JOB_EXECUTION_ID
columns.description: The identifier column for every job request execution

columns.name: JOB_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Foreign key reference to job requests identifier column

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Name of the job definition for this execution request

columns.name: JOB_STATUS
columns.description: This column displays the status of the job execution. Valid values are Running, Successful, Failed, Cancelled

columns.name: CANCEL_REQUEST_STATUS
columns.description: The status for processing the cancellation request

columns.name: JOB_EXECUTION_CONTEXT
columns.description: To store the job execution context such as a job request and etc.

columns.name: JOB_RETRY_NUMBER
columns.description: Job request retry number, starting from 0, which is increased by 1 for every subsequent retry attempt

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: Actual start time of the job

columns.name: END_TIME
columns.description: Actual end time of the job

columns.name: TIMEOUT_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Termination timeout threshold (in seconds), which is used to automatically timeout and terminate a running job

columns.name: ARRAY_JOB_PARENT_ID
columns.description: ID of the parent execution record that represents the overall array job.

columns.name: ARRAY_JOB_INSTANCE_INDEX
columns.description: -2 for manager container running in PRE-PROCESSING mode, -1 for manager container running in POST-PROCESSING mode, 0 for first worker instance, 1 for second worker instance, etc., NULL in all other cases.

columns.name: RETRY_COUNT
columns.description: To store retry count for a single execution, each execution is for a given job retry count

columns.name: IS_PREEMPTION_ALLOWED
columns.description: Indicates whether the job can be preemptively terminated after it is already running

columns.name: SCHEDULING_URGENCY
columns.description: The level of scheduling urgency for the job, e.g. NORMAL, TIME_SENSITIVE, TIME_INSENSITIVE

columns.name: DELAY_TOLERANCE_THRESHOLD
columns.description: The amount of execution delay in seconds that the job can tolerate

columns.name: SCHEDULED_TIME
columns.description: The time at which the job is scheduled to run

columns.name: JOB_RESOURCE_RELEASED
columns.description: Indicate whether the job resources are released. Possible values are NULL, N, Y

columns.name: LAST_PUBLISHED_STATUS
columns.description: Tracks the last status published for Job Scheduler to consume

columns.name: TIMEOUT_DATE
columns.description: The timer set for the current state would expire after the given time

columns.name: VISIBILITY_DATE
columns.description: The visibility flag used to support multiple consumers

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
